notes: Confirmation gate skipped since user unavailable
Plain-text output chosen (no markdown bullets)
'Same length' read as identical lines except platform-only
Hotfix detection: user says so or every PR has hotfix label, else ask
How a release's PRs are defined

Ticket regex false positives
8 assumptions listed in handoff.md
First script-test loop passed '--hotfix' as part of the filename (zsh word splitting); fixed in the test harness
Only 1 run per configuration, so ±std reflects spread across the 3 tests, not run-to-run noise. Treat the +4pt pass-rate delta as directional.
Pass rates barely separate the versions: 14 of 21 assertions pass for both (presence checks: validator, 'Not for', frontmatter, 'has a reason'). The graders flagged these as non-discriminating.

Where the versions differ is quality the assertions miss: the cold read (new) caught a real bug in 2 of 3 runs (hotfix branch skipping the write step; 7 and 11 reader issues fixed in the other runs), and the old version wrote a wrong 'why' for the UTC/Oslo rule in test 3.
Cost: the new version takes ~1.8x the time (+107s) and +14k tokens (+21%), mostly from the cold-read subagent.

Two wording problems in skill-builder itself: (1) personal road-test plans asked for 2-3 prompts but also 'always' a negative and a missing-input prompt, so test 2 produced 4 and failed; (2) 'evals.md next to the skill' is ambiguous (inside vs beside the skill folder).
